name: Minnesota Department of Revenue (individual income tax)
notes: Researched from public revenue.state.mn.us pages only. Individuals pay through the Online Services (e-Services) Payment System without login, or in e-Services after creating an Individual username (I Want To... > Access your personal tax accounts; identity verification before some features). Bank payments free (U.S. accounts only); cards via US Bank: 1.25% debit, 2.15% credit (engine charges the credit rate; debit rate not expressible). Cancel: 5 p.m. Central on the processing day; card payments made without logging in cannot be cancelled. Payment Plan Agreement System for individuals with an SSN who received a bill, no existing agreement, no bankruptcy, no levy; else 651-556-3003 / 800-657-3909. No recurring AutoPay (inferred). Sign-in by username documented (Create an Individual username).

guest_pay.note: Pay individual income tax through the Online Services Payment System without an e-Services login.

autopay.note: e-Services has no recurring automatic payments for income tax. Schedule each payment yourself; you can cancel a bank payment until 5 p.m. Central on its processing date.

scheduled_payment.note: Bank payments can be cancelled until 5 p.m. Central Time on the day they are scheduled to process. Card payments made without logging in cannot be cancelled.

payment_arrangement.note: Request a payment agreement online if you received a bill, have no existing agreement, and are not in bankruptcy or under a levy.

notes: Debit card payments carry a lower 1.25% fee charged by US Bank.

help.title: Ways to pay individual income tax
paragraphs: Pay from a U.S. bank account through the Online Services Payment System; international bank accounts are not accepted. You can also pay by check or money order with a voucher from the Payment Voucher System, or in cash at the department in St. Paul.
Card payments go through US Bank, which charges 1.25% for debit cards and 2.15% for credit cards.
Most payments take 3 to 7 days to process. If yours has not processed within 10 days, call 651-556-3000 or 800-657-3666, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday.

help.title: Cancel a payment
paragraphs: You can cancel a scheduled payment until 5 p.m. Central Time on the day it is set to process. Credit and debit card payments made without logging in cannot be cancelled.

If you paid while logged in to e-Services, choose I Want To..., then Search for a request on the History card, select the payment and choose Cancel Payment. If you paid from a bank account without logging in, use Search for a confirmation number in Online Services with your confirmation number and email address, then Cancel.
For a payment scheduled with your income tax return, contact the department before the payment date at 651-296-3781 or 800-652-9094.

help.title: Payment agreements
paragraphs: If you cannot pay in full, request a payment agreement online with the Payment Plan Agreement System. You qualify online if you are an individual with a Social Security number, received a bill, have no existing agreement, are not in bankruptcy and have no levy against you.
The payment amount is based on your current financial situation using IRS guidelines, and you may be asked for a personal financial statement.
If you cannot set it up online, call 651-556-3003 or 800-657-3909, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., Monday through Friday.

extra.intent: Using the Minnesota Revenue website's help pages, find the time by which a scheduled bank payment must be cancelled on its processing day. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: A bank payment can be cancelled until 5 p.m. Central Time on its processing day.

extra.intent: Using the Minnesota Revenue website's help pages, find the fee percentage for paying with a debit card. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Debit card payments carry a 1.25% fee (credit cards 2.15%).
